name: VoltServer®
old_description: Another step in empowering more industries with intelligent power distribution East Greenwich, April 12, 2024 – VoltServer, a leading provider of Digital Electricity™ (DE), Fault Managed Power solutions, has attained Cisco Select Developer status. This accomplishment demonstrates VoltServer’s expertise and solidifies its position as a trusted and valued collaborator within the industry. The collaboration between VoltServer and Cisco opens new opportunities for both companies to drive innovation in efficient and sustainable power delivery solutions. With VoltServer’s proven expertise in Digital Electricity™ combined with Cisco’s leadership in the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) technologies, the companies are driving advancements in powering industrial and outdoor environments where traditional power sources are limited or inaccessible. VoltServer’s Digital Edge Solutions, combined with Cisco’s IIOT platforms, enable enterprise-grade connectivity in even the most rugged and challenging spaces. Together, they empower organizations to deploy Cisco IE Series Power over Ethernet (PoE) switches deeper into their networks, delivering enhanced efficiency, connectivity, and performance. “We are very excited to become a trusted powering solution for Cisco’s IIoT solutions,” states Matt Giuliano, EVP and GM, Emeritus, Communications and In-Building at VoltServer, “and to continue to work with Cisco’s engineering teams to collectively address joint go-to-market opportunities in several strategic vertical markets including extended campus & outdoor spaces, ports and airports, utilities and oil & gas.” The attainment of Cisco Select Developer status marks a significant milestone for VoltServer as they continue their 10-year deployment history as the industry’s pioneering leader in Fault Managed Power, via their Digital Electricity platform. “We are driven by innovation and are proud to be setting the standard in Fault Managed Power Systems. Together, with our valued partners, we are solving the world’s power distribution demands and building solutions to create a better future for us all,” says Stephen Eaves, CEO and Founder at VoltServer.
about:
VoltServer is headquartered in East Greenwich, Rhode Island. The company was founded by Stephen Eaves, who serves as CEO, and has a 10-year deployment history as of 2024. Matt Giuliano holds the role of EVP and GM, Emeritus, Communications and In-Building.

VoltServer develops and manufactures Digital Electricity™ (DE), a patented fault-managed power system classified as Class 4 under the 2023 National Electrical Code. The technology splits energy into packets transferred from a Transmitter unit to a Receiver unit, with safety monitoring after each packet. The company reports more than 1,000 building installations and 40,000 circuits across large venues.

The company serves telecommunications service providers deploying 5G and Wi-Fi networks, transportation hubs such as ports and airports, enterprise buildings and campuses, industrial manufacturing facilities, data centers, and building electrification projects. VoltServer also collaborates with partners including Cisco, where it holds Select Developer status for IIoT power solutions, and Eaton for critical infrastructure.

VoltServer states its technology reduces installation time by using existing data pathways and hybrid fiber cable, lowers material costs by eliminating conduit, and improves safety by halting hazardous current within milliseconds. The platform is designed for energy efficiency and can qualify for LEED credits. The company says it is driven by innovation and aims to set the standard in fault-managed power systems.
